paragraphs: 3 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Thursday for 3 clubs across 3 levels, with Zach Daudet producing the night's most notable performance.
Zach Daudet drove in 2 runs with a double in the fourth to left field on a 1-0 pitch from Elwis Mijares.
Zach Daudet drove in 1 run with a double in the fourth to left field on a 1-0 pitch from Joel Díaz.
Zach Daudet went 3-for-4, 2 doubles, 3 RBI, 2 runs scored, 1 walk.
He batted seventh and started at shortstop.

Andrew Alvarez started on the mound for Washington Nationals. He worked 5.0 innings, allowing 4 hits and 1 earned run, with 3 walks and 5 strikeouts. One of his strikeouts came in the second on a 3-2 92 mph four-seam fastball, when he put away Brandon Nimmo. Washington Nationals fell to Texas Rangers, 0-2.
Ryan Tayman went 0-for-3, 1 walk for St. Lucie Mets at Single-A. He batted third and started behind the plate. St. Lucie Mets fell to Lakeland Flying Tigers, 2-6.
title: Zach Daudet highlights a busy Thursday for former Mustangs
